digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch delivery and workflow CAS push
propositions: Duplicate CAS push and retry loops across workflows are consolidated into a single Python core implementation at src/rebar/_store/push.py
The strict push delivery mode raises PushDeliveryError with stable reason and unpushed-commit count when retries are exhausted
Workflow adapters delegate delivery once through strict Python entrypoints instead of maintaining local fetch/merge/retry loops
Existing Python library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers retain best-effort default behavior without strict delivery
The locked commit-and-push entrypoint stages, commits, and delivers workflow transactions with established bot identity
Strict delivery failure produces nonzero exit status visible to GitHub Actions after core exhausts the five-cycle retry budget
